The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio. Reaching the terrace of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the wharf of a task receipt, and the saffron is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
